# ak-ui-react

> React port of [ak-ui](https://github.com/YunYouJun/ak-ui) and [prts-design](https://github.com/MooncellWiki/prts-design) — an Arknights-inspired industrial / tactical terminal design system for React.
> Framework-agnostic SCSS and DOM controllers are vendored from upstream; components are implemented in modern React (18 & 19).

Package: `@swufefox/ak-ui-react`
- Repository: https://github.com/SwufeFox/ak-ui-react
- Showcase: https://ak-ui-react.pages.dev
- Generated API Reference: `docs/api.md` (109 components, 115 interfaces)
- Stylesheet: `@swufefox/ak-ui-react/style.css`

---

## 1. Quick Start

### Installation

```bash
npm install @swufefox/ak-ui-react
# or
pnpm add @swufefox/ak-ui-react
# or
bun add @swufefox/ak-ui-react
```

### Import Stylesheet

Import the stylesheet once at your app's root entry file (`main.tsx` or `App.tsx`):

```tsx
import '@swufefox/ak-ui-react/style.css'
```

---

## 2. Core Design Rules & Principles

1. **Terminal Root is Dark by Default**:
   Unlike generic design systems, the canonical Arknights PRTS aesthetic is a high-contrast dark industrial tactical terminal (`#0b0d0f` canvas, `#171a1d` raised panels, `#f8f8f5` text). The library supports light archive mode via `[data-ak-theme="archive"]` or `:root[data-theme="light"]`.
2. **Sharp Geometries & Cut Corners, No Pill Shapes**:
   Never use generic iOS/macOS 16px/24px rounded corners or bubble buttons. Everything in Arknights is rectangular, chamfered (`AkCut`, `clip-path`), bracketed (`AkBrackets`), or tagged with corner markers (`AkCorner`).
3. **Typography Disciplines**:
   - Technical numbers and readouts use monospace/tabular numerals: `--ak-font-mono`, `AkNum`, `.tabular-nums`.
   - Headers and Latin tactical display words use geometric sans: `AkDisplay`, Novecento style.
   - Bilingual pairs (CJK + English subtext): `AkBilingual`.
4. **Signal Colors & Semantic Tokens**:
   - Info / Rhodes Island Cyan: `--ak-signal-info` (`#18d1ff` dark / `#0098dc` light)
   - Action / Hazard Yellow: `--ak-signal-action` (`#ffd800` dark / `#c99d00` light)
   - Danger / Crimson: `--ak-signal-danger` (`#e33b3b`)
   - Accent / Orange: `--ak-color-accent` (`#f6540e`)
   - Surfaces: `--ak-surface-canvas`, `--ak-surface-panel`, `--ak-surface-sunken`, `--ak-surface-raised`
   - Role Palette: `--ak-role-vanguard`, `--ak-role-guard`, `--ak-role-defender`, `--ak-role-sniper`, `--ak-role-caster`, `--ak-role-medic`, `--ak-role-supporter`, `--ak-role-specialist`
   - Terminal Command Tone Palette: `--ak-terminal-paper`, `--ak-terminal-muted`, `--ak-terminal-dark`, `--ak-terminal-cyan`, `--ak-terminal-accent`
5. **Components Never Ship Game Art**:
   Every icon-bearing component receives its icon from caller props (`icon`, `prefixIcon`, or `children`). No hidden bundled image dependencies.

---

## 3. Component Categories & Documentation

### 3.1 Actions & Buttons

#### `AkButton`
Industrial tactile button featuring an animated sweeping light-band highlight on hover, active scale depression, and focus rings.

```tsx
import { AkButton } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Variants: 'default' | 'outline' | 'action' | 'advanced' | 'light'
<AkButton variant="action" icon={<span>◆</span>} onClick={() => deploy()}>
  CONFIRM DEPLOYMENT
</AkButton>

<AkButton variant="outline" block>FULL WIDTH</AkButton>
<AkButton disabled>UNAVAILABLE</AkButton>
```

Props:
- `variant?: 'default' | 'outline' | 'action' | 'advanced' | 'light'` (default: `'default'`)
- `icon?: ReactNode`: Leading inline icon slot
- `block?: boolean` (default: `false`): Stretches to 100% width
- `disabled?: boolean`: Native disabled state

#### `AkButtonGroup`
Horizontal cluster wrapper with unified borders and segment flow.

```tsx
<AkButtonGroup>
  <AkButton variant="outline">PREV</AkButton>
  <AkButton variant="outline">NEXT</AkButton>
</AkButtonGroup>
```

#### `AkTag` / `AkTagGroup`
Tactical status tags with cut chamfer corners and colored signal indicators. Supports button selection state (`aria-pressed`).

```tsx
import { AkTag, AkTagGroup } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

<AkTag variant="advanced">MELEE</AkTag>
<AkTag variant="danger">CROWD CONTROL</AkTag>
// As selectable filter button:
<AkTag as="button" aria-pressed={isSelected} onClick={() => toggle()}>SURVIVAL</AkTag>
```

---

### 3.2 Menus & Disclosure

Backed by the native browser Popover API. Esc, outside click, and top-layer stacking are handled automatically by the platform.

```tsx
import {
  AkDropdownMenu,
  AkContextMenu,
  AkMenubar,
  AkToolbar,
  AkCollapsible,
  AkMenuGroup,
  AkMenuSeparator,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Dropdown Menu:
<AkDropdownMenu
  label="TACTICAL MENU"
  items={[
    { label: 'Inspect Sector', onSelect: () => inspect(), shortcut: '⌘I' },
    { label: 'Deploy Squad', onSelect: () => deploy(), shortcut: '⌘D' },
    { label: 'Abort Operation', destructive: true, onSelect: () => abort() }
  ]}
/>

// Context Menu (Right Click):
<AkContextMenu items={[{ label: 'Archive', onSelect: () => archive() }]}>
  <div className="panel">Right click here</div>
</AkContextMenu>

// Menubar & Toolbar:
<AkMenubar aria-label="Editor Menu">
  <button type="button" role="menuitem">FILE</button>
  <button type="button" role="menuitem">EDIT</button>
</AkMenubar>

// Collapsible disclosure:
<AkCollapsible title="OPERATIONAL BRIEFING">
  <p>Target coordinates confirmed.</p>
</AkCollapsible>
```

---

### 3.3 Cards & Surfaces

#### `AkCard`
Layered rectangular panel with structured header, content, and footer slots.

```tsx
import {
  AkCard,
  AkCardHeader,
  AkCardTitle,
  AkCardDescription,
  AkCardContent,
  AkCardFooter,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

<AkCard as="article" variant="default">
  <AkCardHeader>
    <AkCardTitle>MISSION 01-07</AkCardTitle>
    <AkCardDescription>Sub-surface Originium veins</AkCardDescription>
  </AkCardHeader>
  <AkCardContent>
    Defend all critical extraction gates.
  </AkCardContent>
  <AkCardFooter>
    <AkButton variant="action">START</AkButton>
  </AkCardFooter>
</AkCard>
```

#### Surface Treatments
- `AkBackdrop`: Frosted / blurred glass HUD panel with `strength` ('subtle' | 'base' | 'deep')
- `AkGrain`: Procedural noise overlay for vast empty dark fields
- `AkMosaic`: Data de-sync pixelation block for corrupted/classified data
- `AkVignette`: Darkened corner gradient pushing visual focus inward
- `AkStripeEdge`: High-visibility left hazard stripe edge

---

### 3.4 Feedback & Status

```tsx
import { AkNotice, AkStatus, AkProgress, AkGauge } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Notices with cut corners and technical status code:
<AkNotice title="SYSTEM ALERT" code="PRTS.ERR" variant="danger">
  Catastrophe precursor detected in Sector 4.
</AkNotice>

// Pulse indicator status readout:
<AkStatus label="SYSTEM" detail="Online" variant="info" />
<AkStatus label="COMMS" detail="Degraded" variant="warning" />

// Progress bars and segmented gauges:
<AkProgress value={75} max={100} label="STABILIZING" />
<AkGauge value={4} max={5} label="DIFFICULTY" />
```

---

### 3.5 Inputs & Form

Dark-terminal native inputs with cyan indicators, monospace labels, and custom switch/radio shapes.

```tsx
import {
  AkFormStack,
  AkField,
  AkFieldLabel,
  AkInput,
  AkSelect,
  AkTextarea,
  AkChoice,
  AkSlider,
  AkInputNumber,
  AkSegmented,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

<AkFormStack>
  <AkField hint="ENTER OPERATOR ID">
    <AkFieldLabel htmlFor="op-id">CODE</AkFieldLabel>
    <AkInput id="op-id" placeholder="R001" value={code} onChange={e => setCode(e.target.value)} />
  </AkField>

  <AkField>
    <AkSelect value={role} onChange={e => setRole(e.target.value)}>
      <option value="caster">Caster</option>
      <option value="medic">Medic</option>
    </AkSelect>
  </AkField>

  <AkChoice checked={live} onChange={e => setLive(e.target.checked)}>CHECKLIST CONFIRMED</AkChoice>
  <AkChoice variant="switch" checked={comms} onChange={e => setComms(e.target.checked)}>RADIO LINK</AkChoice>
</AkFormStack>

// Slider & Stepper:
<AkSlider value={volume} onValueChange={setVolume} label="AUDIO GAIN" />
<AkInputNumber value={quantity} onValueChange={setQuantity} min={1} max={99} />
<AkSegmented options={['ALL', 'ELITE 1', 'ELITE 2']} value={stage} onValueChange={setStage} />
```

### 3.6 Navigation

```tsx
import { AkTabs, AkBreadcrumb } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

<AkTabs
  value={activeTab}
  onValueChange={setActiveTab}
  items={[
    { id: 'ops', label: 'OPERATIONS', eyebrow: 'STAGE / 01', content: <div>Combat Stages</div> },
    { id: 'roster', label: 'ROSTER', eyebrow: 'PERSONNEL', content: <div>Operator List</div> },
  ]}
/>

<AkBreadcrumb
  items={[
    { label: 'RHODES ISLAND', href: '#' },
    { label: 'TERMINAL', href: '#' },
    { label: 'INFRASTRUCTURE' }
  ]}
/>
```

### 3.7 Effects & Depth

Motion language built with CSS animations and Web Animations API controllers:

```tsx
import {
  AkEntrance,
  AkCountUp,
  AkDepth,
  AkDepthLayer,
  AkParticleField,
  AkGlow,
  AkOutline,
  AkSkew,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Entrance animation controller with replay():
const entranceRef = useRef<AkEntranceHandle>(null)
<AkEntrance ref={entranceRef}>
  <div>Panel animating in on mount</div>
</AkEntrance>
entranceRef.current?.replay()

// Rolling numeric readout:
<AkCountUp value={2048} duration={800} />

// Mouse-tracking 3D parallax depth:
<AkDepth variant="stage" threeD>
  <AkDepthLayer depth={0.4} className="bg-grid" />
  <AkDepthLayer depth={1.0} className="main-content"><AkDisplay xl>PRTS</AkDisplay></AkDepthLayer>
  <AkDepthLayer depth={2.0} className="hud-brackets" />
</AkDepth>

// Tactical micro-effects:
<AkGlow tone="action"><AkButton>BREATHING GLOW</AkButton></AkGlow>
<AkOutline color="#18d1ff"><AkButton>EXPANDING RING</AkButton></AkOutline>
<AkSkew direction="left"><AkInverse>10 DEGREE SKEW</AkInverse></AkSkew>
```

---

### 3.8 Arknights Game Data Components

Dedicated primitives for Rhodes Island game metrics, ported from MooncellWiki/prts-design:

```tsx
import {
  AkRarity,
  AkRarityScope,
  AkRarityChip,
  AkRarityBar,
  AkProfession,
  AkProfessionLabel,
  AkElite,
  AkPotential,
  AkSpec,
  AkTrust,
  AkSkillLevels,
  AkPotList,
  AkPot,
  AkAttrs,
  AkAttr,
  AkKv,
  AkKvItem,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Star rating (1-6 stars, drawn with CSS clip-path):
<AkRarity level={6} />

// Rarity scope: cascades --ak-r and --ak-r-text to all child elements:
<AkRarityScope level={6}>
  <AkRarityChip level={6}>6★</AkRarityChip>
  <AkRarityBar level={6}><span className="ak-r-text">SIX STAR PROFILE</span></AkRarityBar>
</AkRarityScope>

// Profession badges:
<AkProfession name="caster" boxed size="lg" icon={<span>◇</span>} />
<AkProfessionLabel name="术师" en="CASTER" prof="caster" subProf={<span>✦</span>} subProfLabel="扩散术师" />

// Progression:
<AkElite level={2} icon={<b>E2</b>} />
<AkPotential label="POTENTIAL 6" icon={<b>P6</b>} />
<AkSpec label="MASTERY 3" icon={<b>M3</b>} />
<AkTrust value="200%" />
<AkSkillLevels value={level} onValueChange={setLevel} max="M3" />

// Attributes & KV Tables:
<AkAttrs>
  <AkAttr label="ATK" labelCn="攻击力" value="1280" hint="+95" accent />
  <AkAttr label="DEF" labelCn="防御力" value="450" />
</AkAttrs>

<AkKv>
  <AkKvItem label="FACTION">Rhodes Island</AkKvItem>
  <AkKvItem label="CLASS">Core Caster</AkKvItem>
</AkKv>
```

### 3.9 Readouts & Sanity (SAN)

```tsx
import { AkCounter, AkLevel, AkSpinner, AkSan, AkSanContainer, AkSkeleton } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Resource counter with prefix/suffix icons:
<AkCounter value="42,000" prefixIcon={<span>◆</span>} />

// Stage / Operation badge (with auto-handled "OPERATION" fallback):
<AkLevel label="STAGE">01-07</AkLevel>

// Arknights 45° diamond spinner:
<AkSpinner color="#ffd800" />

// Standalone Sanity meter:
<AkSan current={120} total={135} onAdd={() => refill()} />

// Full Sanity panel container:
<AkSanContainer
  variant="compact"
  eyebrow="RHODES ISLAND"
  title="SANITY"
  current={120}
  total={135}
  onAdd={() => refill()}
  meta={<AkLevel>01-07</AkLevel>}
  status="RESTORED"
/>
```

### 3.10 Collections & Tables

```tsx
import {
  AkTable,
  AkAvatar,
  AkAvatarGroup,
  AkThumbnail,
  AkScrollArea,
  AkNewsList,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Tactical table with hairline dividers, overline headers, and selection rails:
<AkTable
  columns={[
    { key: 'id', title: 'OPERATOR ID' },
    { key: 'name', title: 'NAME' },
    { key: 'level', title: 'LEVEL', align: 'end' },
  ]}
  data={[
    { id: 'R001', name: 'Amiya', level: 80 },
    { id: 'R002', name: 'Kal\'tsit', level: 90 },
  ]}
  selectedKey="R001"
  onRowClick={row => handleSelect(row)}
/>

// Sharp cut avatars (no generic circles!):
<AkAvatarGroup>
  <AkAvatar fallback="AMIYA" cut />
  <AkAvatar fallback="KAL" cut />
</AkAvatarGroup>
```

### 3.11 Command Deck, Screens, Slots & Items (Upstream New Additions)

Synchronized with `YunYouJun/ak-ui` terminal and item architecture:

```tsx
import {
  AkCommandGrid,
  AkCommand,
  AkSlot,
  AkItem,
  AkScreen,
} from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react'

// Terminal Command Grid:
<AkCommandGrid>
  <AkCommand label="OPERATIONS" meta="COMBAT // 01-07" tone="danger" onClick={() => openScreen('combat')} />
  <AkCommand label="SQUAD" meta="FORMATION" tone="action" onClick={() => openScreen('squad')} />
  <AkCommand label="DEPOT" meta="SUPPLY" tone="info" onClick={() => openScreen('depot')} />
</AkCommandGrid>

// Operator Card Slot:
<AkSlot
  name="AMIYA"
  role="caster"
  rarity={5}
  code="CAS"
  meta="LV.80"
  rarityLabel="★★★★★"
  onClick={() => inspect()}
/>

<AkSlot empty><span>+ ASSIGN</span></AkSlot>

// Material Item Tile (T1 to T6):
<AkItem tier={5} name="D32 STEEL" count="x4" onClick={() => viewItem()} />
<AkItem tier={3} name="MANGANESE" count="x12" />
<AkItem tier={4} name="LMD" price="5,000" sold />

// Function Screen (Full-page terminal panel with shutter entrance and tone styling):
<AkScreen
  tone="dark" // 'dark' | 'paper' | 'muted' | 'cyan'
  title="DEPOT"
  eyebrow="MANAGEMENT // 01"
  backLabel="RETURN"
  onBack={() => closeScreen()}
  meta={<span>LMD: 42,000 ◆</span>}
  watermark="RHODES"
>
  <div className="ak-screen__grid">
    <AkItem tier={5} name="D32 STEEL" count="x4" />
    <AkItem tier={4} name="ORUNDUM" count="x1,800" />
  </div>
</AkScreen>
```

## 4. Subpath Exports & Controllers

Framework-agnostic controllers are accessible via subpaths without React dependencies:

```ts
import { createSectionNavigation, createMediaGallery } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react/core'
import { createCountUp, createEntrance } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react/core/effects'
import { createDashboardDepth } from '@swufefox/ak-ui-react/core/depth'
```

---

## 5. Summary of Common Mistakes to Avoid

| Anti-pattern | Recommended Pattern | Reason |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Round avatars (`border-radius: 50%`) | Rectangular or chamfer cut avatars (`<AkAvatar cut />`) | Arknights design language strictly forbids bubbly round cards/avatars |
| Hardcoded `#fff` or `#000` colors | `var(--ak-text-primary)`, `var(--ak-surface-canvas)` | Breaks theme inversion between Terminal (dark) and Archive (light) |
| Fixed widths on buttons (`width: 150px`) | `min-width: 120px; width: auto;` (built into `AkButton`) | Avoids text clipping on longer phrases and CJK/English labels |
| Hand-rolled CSS diagonal stripes | `<AkStripes variant="hazard" />` or `<AkGridBackdrop />` | Reuses canonical vector-math SVG/CSS tokens across the system |
| Generic spinner icons | `<AkSpinner />` | Retains Arknights 45-degree rotating diamond radio-wave indicator |
| Unstyled tooltips/popovers sticking out on mobile | `<AkPopover />` | Built-in `min(calc(100vw - 32px), ...)` prevents mobile viewport blowout |
